scripts.zip: npm run verify && npm run release:zip -w @chatenhancer/repo-tools
scripts.cloudflare:check: npm run check:deploy -w @chatenhancer/language-redirect && npm run check:deploy -w @chatenhancer/playground
scripts.demo:walkthrough: npm run build:chrome && npm run walkthrough:capture-locales -w @chatenhancer/repo-tools
scripts.demo:walkthrough:preview: npm run build:chrome && npm run walkthrough:capture -w @chatenhancer/repo-tools -- --preview
scripts.demo:walkthrough:release: npm run demo:walkthrough && npm run walkthrough:publish -w @chatenhancer/repo-tools
scripts.publish:safari: npm run build:safari:xcode -w @chatenhancer/extension && npm run safari:distribute -w @chatenhancer/repo-tools -- --upload && npm run publish:safari -w @chatenhancer/repo-tools
scripts.test: npm run test:unit -w @chatenhancer/repo-tools && npm run cloudflare:test && npm run test -w @chatenhancer/docs
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:perf
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:unit -w @chatenhancer/repo-tools -- --coverage && npm run coverage:notice -w @chatenhancer/repo-tools
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && eslint eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check --workspaces --if-present && eslint eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run cloudflare:test && npm run cloudflare:check && npm run test:e2e:ci -w @chatenhancer/extension
